title: Size of stack vents and vent stacks.
officialText:
The minimum required diameter of stack vents and vent stacks shall be determined
from the developed length and the total of drainage fixture units connected thereto in accordance with Table 916.1, but in no case
shall the diameter be less than one-half the diameter of the drain served or less than 11/2 inches (38 mm).
